name: loyalty-points
description: Habiturn — From first visit to 'the usual'. Loyalty for small shops: NestJS API + React website, SQLite storage.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
